evals.prompt: Research UTV and ATV cab cooling fans across YouTube, Reddit, Amazon, X, and TikTok. I need product, listing, and content recommendations, with browser-assisted social sampling and no CAPTCHA bypass.
evals.expected_output: A study contract, source plan, canonical evidence package, audited coding workflow, source-specific statistics, quality status, and traceable report without a blended cross-platform sentiment rate.
expectations: Uses browser-assisted samples with explicit stop conditions
Requires deterministic statistics and source IDs

evals.prompt: Collect about 100 public records to understand NorthTrail brand reputation. Prefer Chrome-style human browsing; if X is blocked use my authorized paid X API. Include Amazon and Reddit evidence.
evals.expected_output: A bounded browser-first source plan, X API fallback with cost manifest, access-mode labels, cleaning and viral-thread caps, annotation audit, and a reputation report with evidence links.
expectations: Does not scale browser access into unattended scraping
Distinguishes verified purchase, owned use, and questions
Records API fallback and resource use

evals.prompt: Combine an exported customer-support CSV with competitor Amazon reviews and YouTube comments to identify the top product defects and update our FAQ.
evals.expected_output: Privacy-aware first-party import, separate operational and public-source denominators, defect taxonomy, low-rating and service cross-tabs, evidence excerpts, and FAQ recommendations qualified by the quality gate.
expectations: Removes direct identifiers from normalized records
Does not calculate a support rate without an eligible-order denominator
Uses a calibrated taxonomy and audit

evals.prompt: Do a deep product-improvement VOC study for a UTV windshield protector. Use YouTube, public UTV forums, Old Reddit, Amazon, X, TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram. YouTube has an API key. Decide the total evidence target and channel allocation before collecting.
evals.expected_output: A decision-depth sample plan that makes YouTube, public forums, and Old Reddit the core; uses the YouTube API first for search, metadata, comments, and replies; separates public-caption recovery; assigns small but interpretable floors to high-risk social sources; and gates both record counts and independent parents.
expectations: Does not allocate an equal fixed count to every channel
Uses the YouTube Data API before browser collection for YouTube
Keeps transcript-video and comment denominators separate
Requires record and independent-parent floors for core sources
Treats high-risk social sources below 30 records or 10 parents as case supplements
